# The golden home

A small ParleyInn home the 0.0.0 build wrote at M1's close: the proving
slice's transcript, ingested once. `parinn verify` and a recall of fixed
addresses in the current build must give the bytes under `expected/`
(`crates/parinn/tests/e2e_golden_home.rs`). A later version adds its own
sibling directory and a migration test that opens this one (ENG-23).

## Its keys are not a secret

`home/keys` holds four key files, made for this home and used nowhere
else: a device key, a recovery key and two seat keys. They guard nothing
and are committed on purpose. A secret scan that flags them is
a false positive; allow the path `testdata/golden-home/`. Never put a key
of a real home here.

## Writing it again

Only for a change of format on purpose, which also needs a migration
from this version:

```text
cargo test -p parinn --test e2e_golden_home -- --ignored regenerate
```

The test copies the home before it reads it, so a read never changes the
committed files.

## Its machine

A home is bound to the node identity it started under (REC-24). The test
pins a fixed identity file, so the home reads the same on every machine.
